    For college coaches

    Recruit a Buffalo

    College coaches: everything you need on our players is in one place. Player cards in the roster link to film, stats, and recruiting profiles as they are added.

    • Full game film and highlight reels on request
    • Transcripts and academic details through the head coach
    • Recruiting profiles for featured players, linked on their cards
    • Visits welcome at any home game or practice
